newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Heritage trust sells $100 mln stock.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Heritage trust sells $100 mln stock.

text.p: Peoples Heritage Financial Group Inc said Wednesday a business trust which it formed has sold in a private transaction $100 million of 9.06 percent capital securities.
Proceeds from the sale will be used by the trust, known as Peoples Heritage Capital Trust I, to buy Peoples Heritage Financial junior subordinated debentures due Feb. 1, 2027.
Peoples Heritage Financial said it will use proceeds from the issuance of the debentures for general corporate purposes.
Proceeds from the sale of the securities will qualify as Tier 1 capital under guidelines of the Federal Reserve Board, it said.

The capital securities have not been registered with federal securities regulators and may not be offered or sold in the United States without registration or an applicable exemption from registration requirements, it said.
